gold.user: A developer wants to retrieve all dynamic webhooks associated with their Jira app to ensure they are set up correctly.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of dynamic webhooks, including their IDs, URLs, and events they are listening to.

gold.user: A developer is registering a new dynamic webhook for their Jira app to receive notifications for issue updates.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the webhook details and return a confirmation with the newly created webhook ID.

gold.user: A developer needs to delete an outdated webhook that is no longer needed for their app.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified webhook and return a success message.

gold.user: An administrator wants to check the list of failed webhooks to troubleshoot issues with notifications.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of failed webhooks, including error messages and timestamps of the failures.

gold.user: A developer wants to refresh all webhooks to ensure they are up to date with the latest configuration.
gold.ideal: The API should refresh the webhooks and return a success message indicating that the refresh was completed.
